description: Cloudflare Workers static assets deployed by Workers Builds: main deploys, every branch gets a preview URL.
wranglerNotes: Cloudflare Workers serving the built site as static assets. One Worker: Workers Builds deploys
main to production and uploads preview versions for other branches (DEPLOYING.md).
Response headers for assets live in public/_headers.

pitfalls: Environment blocks in `wrangler.jsonc` don't inherit `vars` or bindings. Repeat them in each environment.

manual: Push to GitHub, deploy once with `pnpm deploy`, then connect the repo in Workers Builds (DEPLOYING.md).
